learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn how to build new words using word parts and discover fun idioms with hidden meanings!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A Prefix is added to the front of a word (un + happy = unhappy). A Suffix is added to the end of a word (care + ful = careful). They change the meaning completely!
When two small words join hands to make a brand new word, it is called a compound word. Example: Sun + Flower = Sunflower! Rain + Bow = Rainbow!
Idioms are special phrases that have a secret hidden meaning! If someone says a test was a piece of cake, they do not mean real cake, they mean the test was very easy.

fun_activity.title: ➕ Compound Word Match
fun_activity.instructions: Write down 'Tooth', 'Pan', and 'Jelly' on paper. Now find words like 'Brush', 'Fish', and 'Cake' to join them and make new words!

quick_recap: ⭐ Prefixes go at the start of a word, and Suffixes go at the end.
⭐ Compound words are made by gluing two smaller words together.
⭐ Idioms are fun phrases that mean something different from the exact words.
